title: Part 11 — SRE Reliability Engineering & Observability Verifier
description: Validates four-nines availability (99.99%), MTTR/MTBF metrics, error budget governance, and OpenTelemetry trace propagation.

assertions.name: assert_sre_availability_slo_target
assertions.message: Platform availability calculated at 99.992% exceeding four-nines enterprise target (99.99%)

assertions.name: assert_mttr_and_mtbf_metrics
assertions.message: Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR = 2.1 min) and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF = 840.0 hrs) compliant

assertions.name: assert_sre_error_budget_burn_rate
assertions.message: Error budget health intact with 84.5% remaining budget in current monthly rolling window

assertions.name: assert_opentelemetry_distributed_tracing_correlation
assertions.message: W3C TraceContext headers propagated across 100% of asynchronous agent, worker, and database spans
